newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen oscillating.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen oscillating.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.61 percent on Friday and traders said the SBI index was expected to remain between 1,280 and 1,320 points over the coming week in expectation of ratification of the EU association accord.

"If Slovenia ratifies the agreement by the end of May then shares will start rising slowly, but if that does not happen the index could fall to its January level of about 1,150 points over the next three months," a trader said.
* The blue-chip SBI index fell 8.03 points to 1,298.29.
* Health resort operator Terme Catez was most actively traded, down 3.03 percent to 11,520 tolars on volume of 1,372 shares.

Traders said Catez fell because of general poor liquidity but added it was not expected to decline further because of its good business results and solid expansion plans. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
